identification: Boosey & Co 'Solbron' (Registered) Class A 'Home Model' Light Valve silver-plated Bb cornet, Boosey & Co Makers, 295 Regent St, London, serial 83914 or 83214 (photo ambiguous), c.1905-1910 by Boosey serial ranges (1903 Class A cornets sold in the 7xxxx-8xxxx range; 1925 about 122845). Bell engraved for the retailer 'Findlay's Proprietary, Sole Agents, Launceston & N.W. Tasmania'. Shepherd's-crook-free short model with 3 pistons, mouthpiece apparently in the leadpipe, nickel lyre present. Original black pebbled leather/rexine coffin-style case with brass lock, two leather straps (one strap end torn), blue velvet lining, leather pocket. Plating worn and dull, no obvious major dents in the photo. Estimate A$80-120, current bid A$40.
